summary_en: Introduces a voxel-based neural implicit surface reconstruction framework specialized for forward-looking sonar. Sonar-NeuS stores signed-distance features in voxel grids and uses sonar-aware hierarchical sampling along the elevation ambiguity arc, substantially reducing reconstruction time while retaining high-quality surface recovery on simulated and real sonar data.
